name: visual-coding
description: A multimodal visual coding agent, MCP plugins, and five fixed evaluation tasks.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix visual-coding-plugins ci && npm --prefix visual-coding-agent ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix visual-coding-plugins run build && npm --prefix visual-coding-agent run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix visual-coding-plugins test && npm --prefix visual-coding-agent test
